g.text: Paired differences on identical frozen inputs and policies; positive values mean larger local results.
Dots: seeded realizations paired between controllers; diamonds: medians, not confidence intervals. Mechanism fixtures excluded.
The same realization appears under both strategies and is not an additional independent sample.
Observation age is simulated and conditional on each controller's retained contributions; retained sets may differ.
Query coverage and MAE describe retrospective public-only reconstruction. No privacy claim or measured delivery latency.
Row labels give all realizations; panel annotations show defined pairs when fewer outcomes are available.
